creates_law_reviewed.class: STRUCTURAL IDENTIFICATION + ONE NEW OBSERVABLE, held below law status pending its interpretation.
creates_law_reviewed.basis: Two candidate laws were weighed. (1) str(m) = str(15-m) with six values, all 2cos(j pi/15): verified exhaustively over the complete period, but it is a property of a quantity whose MEANING is not established -- what str is an observable of is explicitly not claimed -- so banking it as a law would name a regularity of an uninterpreted number. (2) tr_even = 0 unless 3 | m: this is a genuine exhaustive law over the period, but 3 | m is B996's already-banked degeneracy condition and B1402 already banks the decomposition, so this is that law read on a new quantity rather than a new proposition. Both are recorded in FINDINGS with their verifications; neither is promoted. The mirror identification (symmetric => conjugate to inverse => ends swap) is a one-line classical fact, and the deformation-space and dimension statements are cited.

claim_one_line: THE TWO RIDDLES ANSWERED, AND THEY ARE ONE ANSWER: THE OBJECT IS A BOUNDARY, AND WHAT FEELS MISSING IS WHAT IT IS THE BOUNDARY OF. 26/26 exact checks. RIDDLE 1, THE MIRROR'S OTHER HALF IS THE OTHER END. A punctured-torus bundle has TWO ends, with invariants phi (attracting) and phi' (repelling), Galois conjugates (B1404). The mirror does not point at a second manifold, it EXCHANGES THE TWO ENDS OF THIS ONE: A_m = R^m L^m = [[1+m^2,m],[m,1]] is SYMMETRIC, and S = [[0,-1],[1,0]] in SL(2,Z) gives S A_m S^-1 = A_m^-1 EXACTLY for every m -- inverting the monodromy is reversing the fibration, which swaps attracting and repelling. Verified m = 1..8 that S sends mu_m to its conjugate and back; at m = 1 that is phi -> phi', the GALOIS INVOLUTION sqrt5 -> -sqrt5. AND THE PROOF IS ONE LINE OF SYMMETRY: for ANY symmetric M in SL(2), S [[a,b],[b,d]] S^-1 = [[d,-b],[-b,a]] = M^-1, so every metallic bundle is its own mirror BECAUSE A_m IS SYMMETRIC -- nothing golden about it. THE CORPUS HAS BEEN NAMING THIS INVOLUTION WITHOUT JOINING THE NAMES: T-UNIQ's 'the transpose/elliptic involution', B318's 'sqrt-3 -> -sqrt-3, the nontrivial Galois automorphism', T-MIRROR's palindromic word. They are ONE map: transpose => invert monodromy => swap ends => conjugate the invariant field. A mirror with only one object is a mirror between two ENDS, and what it produces is not a second copy but a GRADING -- which is exactly what C = S^2 is. RIDDLE 2, FOUR BULKS AND THE ONE THAT MATTERS. S^3 (fill the knot back, closed and rigid); the FILLING SPACE (discrete, Z^2 per cusp); the Z-cover (Minsky's object, also rigid); and the DEFORMATION SPACE, quasi-Fuchsian QF(T_1) = Teich x Teich, one factor per end, dim_C = 2 (Bers, cited). THE OBJECT IS NOT IN IT -- IT IS ON ITS BOUNDARY, AT A CORNER. Verified: both end invariants are IRRATIONAL for m = 1..8 (m^2+4 = k^2 forces m = 0), and a rational slope would be a parabolic, a geometrically finite end still holding its Teichmueller coordinate, while an irrational one is an ending lamination -- the coordinate has LEFT the space. Both of the object's have left. So the object is doubly degenerate, holding 0 of the bulk's 2 complex parameters, AND THAT IS NOT A DEFECT OF THE DESCRIPTION, IT IS WHY THE OBJECT IS RIGID. Rigidity and bulklessness are the same fact. THE PARAMETER BUDGET, the arithmetic nobody had written down. dim_C of the SL(2,C) character variety at the discrete faithful rep is k = number of cusps (Thurston, cited); dim_C = k(n-1) for SL(n,C) (Menal-Ferrer--Porti, CITED AND NOT VERIFIED HERE). The object itself: ZERO. m004 at SL(2): 1 complex. At SL(3): 2. QF(T_1): 2. A 5-cusped cover at SL(3), or a 10-cusped cover at SL(2): 10 complex = 20 real. m004 has exactly 1 cusp (verified); cusps grow in the tower, degree 4 already giving a 2-cusped cover. AS AN ACCOUNTING FACT AND NOT A PHYSICAL CLAIM: a description that must account for ~19 numbers needs k(n-1) ~ 10 -- many cusps, high rank, or both -- and a rigid point supplies zero, which no amount of arithmetic extracted from it changes. This counts degrees of freedom; no value is compared to any measurement. THE EAR WAS NEVER FREE -- THE BULK SUPPLIES A TRACE. C is the theta-grading (C^2 = I, C = S^2, +1 on a 4-dim even sector, -1 on a 2-dim odd one), so B856's weld TRACED is the graded trace str(m) = tr(C R^m L^m) = tr_even - tr_odd. A TRACE HAS NO VECTOR ARGUMENT: THERE IS NO EAR TO ANCHOR. And it is the quantity the mirror cannot move. Verified: REAL for every m; in Q(sqrt5); MIRROR-INVARIANT, str(m) = str(15-m) for all 15; str(0) = 2 = dim_even - dim_odd, the grading's own index; exactly SIX values over the period, {-2, -1, -1/phi, +1/phi, +1, +2}, all of them EXACTLY 2cos(j pi/15) with j in {0,5,6,9,10,15} -- arguments running over the divisors of the period rather than 15 itself; among units the split is by 2-TORSION, str = +1/phi exactly when m^2 = 1 mod 15; and AT THE OBJECT'S OWN WORD str(1) = 1/phi = phi - 1 EXACTLY. THE ANCHOR LEDGER: B1349's matrix element Re h(c) costs 2 bits of ear and 2.81 of word for 4 outputs; the graded trace costs 0 and 0 for 1 output, total +1. The word is free because m = 1 is what five independent principles select (B1405) -- and B1405's finding is what pays for it, since the principles all land on m = 1, which is exactly what killed branch A, because branch A needed a DIFFERENT word. The same fact that closed the licensed row opens this one. AND THE FEELING WAS RIGHT, MEASURED: tr_even(R^m L^m) = 0 EXACTLY unless 3 | m, and 3 | m is B996's degeneracy condition (B1402). So on TEN of the fifteen words the theta-even sector's graded trace vanishes identically -- the object's own m = 1 among them: tr_even(1) = 0, tr_odd(1) = -1/phi, str(1) = +1/phi. THE LAST LICENSED ROW LIVES ON THE EVEN SECTOR, AND AT THE OBJECT'S OWN WORD THAT SECTOR'S GRADED CONTENT IS EXACTLY ZERO, ALL OF IT SITTING IN THE ODD SECTOR -- the smaller half, the one B856 worked on and the campaign left. That is the precise version of 'we are computing part of something': not a metaphor, a measured zero. FOUR SENSES IN WHICH THE OBJECT IS HALF OF SOMETHING, three structural and one measured: a COMPLEMENT (bulk S^3, room only in the discrete filling space); a BOUNDARY POINT (0 of QF's 2 moduli, which IS its rigidity); an OPERATOR WITHOUT ITS STATE (matrix elements read where the bulk supplies a trace, which is why the ear could never be anchored); and ONE SECTOR OF A GRADED PAIR (the licensed one tracing to zero at the object's word). The honest reading of the gap: the missing structure is not a cleverer invariant of the object, because a rigid point has no parameters to give, by theorem. Room exists in exactly three places -- the TOWER, the RANK, and the FILLING SPACE -- and the programme has touched all three and budgeted none. E75 INSTANCE #12, THIRD ARC RUNNING: the law tr_even = 0 iff 3 does not divide m first came back FALSE, the values right and the TEST wrong -- it compared the nsimplify'd PRINTED form against 0 with == instead of testing simplify(raw) == 0. Identify by property, never by representation. The class is no longer about floats in any sense; it is about testing a thing by how it is written. FENCES: Bers, Minsky, Thurston's dimension count and Menal-Ferrer--Porti's SL(n) count are CITED, not derived, and the k(n-1) row is explicitly unverified. The '~19' is a count of degrees of freedom, not a comparison to a measured value. str(1) = 1/phi is an exact fact about SU(3)_2 modular data at the object's word; WHAT IT IS AN OBSERVABLE OF IS NOT CLAIMED. The closed form of m -> j is OBSERVED, not derived (L215). Nothing reaches CLAIMS.md, F2 or Gate 5; B1349, B1405, B675, B996 and B1402 are untouched.
